description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding in the rear garden of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development ereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwelinghousse.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (TPP20190702-00, TPP20190702-01 & TPP20190702-02, received on 30/07/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the outbuilding without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be used other than for purposes incidental to the occupation of the main dwelling and for the avoidance of doubt shall not be used as primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or living room or for business purposes.

Condition : 6 - Prior to first use of the building hereby approved, the existing  outbuilding  identified to be demolished on plan PP20190702-00 shall have been demolished and the debris removed from the site.
